methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops delivered by a local native to Hampton Roads represents grassroots capability-building outside traditional tech hubs, signaling potential for distributed peer-learning networks that could spread deep fluency beyond NoVA's concentration.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's partnership with AI Ready RVA demonstrates institutional commitment to community-wide AI education and innovation, creating infrastructure for distributed deep learning that could establish Richmond as a secondary hub with genuine capability depth.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab represents concentrated institutional investment in AI leadership preparation, but without evidence of broader regional distribution mechanisms, it risks creating isolated pockets of expertise rather than distributed capability.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: Pressure on Richmond's young workforce to adopt AI tools suggests platform-driven shallow adoption as workers respond to economic necessity rather than deep capability development, pointing toward broad but surface-level AI integration.

signals.title: NoVa lawmakers take AI cash while residents resist data centers - opensecrets.org
signals.signal_reading: NoVA lawmakers accepting AI industry cash while residents resist data centers reveals a disconnect between concentrated AI infrastructure investment and community buy-in, potentially stalling both depth of local capability and distributed benefit-sharing.
